comments.note: StringListParameter.filterValues() casts each item to string before trimming. This is intentional and safe since the method accepts mixed array values (matching the IDListParameter approach), but it means non-string non-null array items are silently coerced rather than warned about. If strict string-only arrays are needed in future, a type-guard with a warning would be cleaner — low priority since the use-case is request parsing where all values are strings anyway.

The requireValidType() method in both IDListParameter and StringListParameter is nearly identical (null→empty array, array passthrough, string→explodeTrim, throw otherwise). This shared logic could be extracted to a protected method in BaseAPIParameter or a shared trait to reduce duplication — but this is out-of-scope for WP-001.

StringListParameter.php: implementation is clean, follows IDListParameter patterns precisely, and is purely additive. Fix-Forward applied: the @param docblock on selectValue() said 'Set to NULL to reset' which is ambiguous. The actual behaviour is identical to setDefaultValue(null): null is converted to [] (empty array) by requireValidType(), so the selected value becomes [] — not null — and getValue() returns [] rather than falling through to request resolution. Updated docblock to 'Set to NULL to reset to an empty array' to match the actual contract.
Test suite: 18 test methods, good coverage across all required AC scenarios. The selectValue(null) edge case is untested (QA-noted) — low risk, acceptable gap.
No blocking issues found. All three acceptance criteria confirmed met by prior pipeline stages.

comments.note: Fixed misleading docblock on StringListParameter::selectValue(). The @param annotation said 'Set to NULL to reset' — implying the selection would be cleared and fall through to request/default resolution. In fact, null is passed through requireValidType() which returns [], then filterValues([]) returns [], and parent::selectValue([]) stores [] as the selected value. Since [] !== null, getValue() returns [] rather than falling through. Corrected to 'Set to NULL to reset to an empty array', consistent with the setDefaultValue(null) docblock. No behavioural change.

selectValue() return type is declared as 'self' rather than 'BaseAPIParameter' (as IDListParameter does). This is correct and superior — it preserves the fluent interface type at the concrete class level without requiring a cast at call sites. IDListParameter should be updated to match this pattern in a future WP.

[documentation-forward] StringListParameter class docblock is minimal. Consider adding a usage example showing comma-separated string input and the resulting array, and documenting the null-resolves-to-null and all-empty-resolves-to-null behaviours. This would make the class self-documenting for API consumers without needing to read the source.

[documentation-forward] The @property annotation '/** @property string[] $defaultValue */' on StringListParameter is accurate but non-standard for PHP property promotion. A more conventional approach would be to use @var on the property declaration in BaseAPIParameter, or add a note clarifying that this overrides the parent's mixed-type property for IDE tooling purposes.
